_readme: Hand-annotated ground truth for the 20 provided scenarios (input line i <-> i-th SIIS record). Written by the team BEFORE tuning thresholds; fit verdicts for lines 1, 7, 9, 11, 18 were confirmed by the team lead (decision D1), line 6 follows the same rule. must_have: every regex group must match some action (completeness). must_not: no action may match (correctness / no off-topic content). deeplinks: expected resolution for specific steps; 'DUMMY' = voiceassist://dummy_positive, null = no deeplink.

scenarios.rationale: Doc is about the e-mail SERVER not responding; complaint is the display flashing/blanking when opening Gmail. Only app-generic remedies (clear cache/data, safe mode) apply; PC access, internet and provider steps address a different symptom.

Blank/white screen inside apps on a phone that is ON. The blank-display doc fits; the force restart is the core remedy. Revised after review: 'charge for 1 hour / attempt power-on' target a device that does not turn on, so they are not required here.

Generic 'things to check first' doc: data access with mouse/keyboard, damage check, force restart are relevant; fingerprint / Kids PIN / device-lock / keyboard sections are unrelated to a black Fold screen.
Black screen on its own -> blank/black display doc fits fully.
Complaint is about Data Transfer's QR step; doc is the Data Transfer procedure (truncated). Steps are app actions, not Settings screens -> manual.
Dark tablet screen with only three icons lit vs a Multi-window / App-pairs how-to: no step addresses the fault. Same rule as D1 (doc context absent from complaint, no generic remedies).
Phone main screen stays small vs Screen mirroring to a TV. The 'image looks small' tip is about the TV mirror, not the phone display (D1).
Inner screen dead (no image/touch): doc explains accessing data via mouse/HDMI then repair.
Fold screen flickers when opened vs Camera video flicker (lighting / shutter speed). Only escalation text is generic -> no viable solution (D1).
Half-black Fold screen: same generic doc as line 3.
Floating shortcut circle (an accessibility assistant menu) vs Multi-window / App pairs doc: wrong document (D1).
Blank screen after carrier switch -> blank/black display doc.
Totally cracked screen: only professional repair options exist in the doc; no software step should be invented.
Won't start, blue/black screen -> blank/black display doc.
Screen flashes when a charger is plugged in; doc is 'blank display'. Generic parts (inspect charger/cable, force restart) apply; 'charge for 1 hour / attempt power on' address a dead device.
Blank screen, cannot use Data Transfer -> same generic doc as line 3.
Multi-intent (crack at fold + dead touch zones + poor visibility): all three are screen-damage consequences served by the repair options of the cracked-screen doc.
Distorted screen vs 'screen does not rotate' doc: only generic remedies (damage check, restart, factory reset with prior backup, support) apply (D1). Orientation steps must not appear.

Touch lag vs touchscreen doc: full fit. Touch sensitivity is conditional on the screen protector -> both polarities; full-screen gestures -> Navigation bar screen; reset last with grounded backup first.
Black screen but phone rings -> blank/black display doc.
